source: AglaSem Docs copy of the NTA master question paper (CUET UG 2026 Question Paper Accountancy, 54 numbered pages plus a cover), downloaded 21 Nov 2026 with the owner's approval. structure: Section 1 Accountancy Core: 45 questions, all to be attempted (225 marks). Then a choice of ONE optional Part: Section 2 Analysis of Financial Statements (5 questions) or Section 3 Computerized Accounting Systems (5 questions), 25 marks each. A candidate answers 50 of the 55.
authentication: A question is authenticated when its printed NTA question id is in the 20-05-2026 (First) final key and the key option id is one of its four printed option ids. Printed option ids are consecutive per question.
